method: Warm public run calls; single CPU thread; 0.5 s warmup then >=50 ms timing blocks; median of all collected blocks, including repeats; setup and upload excluded; GPU synchronization included. GPU FFT-only baseline queues eight batches per synchronization. The template bank is drawn from the CAPTURED PyCBC reference profile (tests/data/reference_profile_pycbc.npy), not a synthetic inspiral curve. Hierarchical rows are recorded at SNR thresholds 5.0, 5.5, 5.75, 6.0 and 6.5; the static chart shows 5.5 and the comparison page selects among them. gravity-dev2's CPU rows were measured while an unrelated eight-process workload saturated the host: its FFTW baseline is 96.18 ms against 78.32 ms recorded on an idle machine, so that row reflects memory-bandwidth contention rather than this revision. Its GPU rows are unaffected (rocFFT within 0.5%).
